documents.text: Mario Arteaga Mario Alberto Arteaga Herrera (born 29 November 1970 in Guadalajara, Jalisco) is a retired professional Mexican footballer. He played as forward during his career, beginning with Chivas in the 1990-91 season. During the following year, Arteaga led Chivas with 9 goals as the club reached the playoff phase. He struggled to recapture that form, however, scoring only 5 goals the next year and 3 goals with León during the 1993-94 season as his top-flight career began to wind down.
